current_difficulty_reason: Orbit equivalence of each vertex action does not directly produce a free action of the graph product on a common probability space. The same construction must still preserve probability measure and nontrivial reduced words, so the action/freeness construction remains a substantive obligation after the source normal-form theorem is allowed.
